correctness.rationale: For the smooth conic C in P^2, no coordinate point lies on C; both points of C have supports of size >=2, so their supports meet and coordinatewise multiplication has no base points. Its pullback of O(1) to C x C = P^1 x P^1 is O(2,2), which is ample, making the proper map finite and surjective; the self-intersection (2,2)^2=8 gives degree eight. Simultaneous projective coordinate signs V=(Z/2)^2 and interchange tau commute, act faithfully and preserve the products, and supply all eight deck transformations in separable characteristic zero. Nonidentity pure signs have only isolated fixed points, whereas the four involutions tau*epsilon fix graphs with bidegree (1,1), whose images under mu are the four lines z0 +/- z1 +/- z2=0. Generic ramification index is 2; no other divisorial inertia appears. The V-invariant and tau-anti-invariant w=x0^2 y1^2-x1^2 y0^2 satisfies w^2=(z0^2+z1^2-z2^2)^2-4z0^2z1^2, the product of these four line equations. The intermediate normal quadratic cover is the associated quartic double plane. Every triple of branch-line normals has determinant absolute value 4, hence there are six transverse pairwise line crossings; each yields w^2=uv, an A1 node and no further singularities. Double-cover adjunction gives K_Y=-pi^*H and K_Y^2=2, with a crepant weak del Pezzo minimal resolution. Independently verified quartic identities and four triple determinants symbolically; these tests do not independently establish the Galois argument.
residual_risks: The construction is established only in characteristic zero; characteristic two invalidates the separable double-cover equation.
Codimension-one inertia gives branch support and e=2; pairwise crossings require the separate normality and local A1 argument.
